cap_confirmation: driver state level_cap 96 (Wally VR beaten); offset-1 members L95, Latios offset 2 L96 = cap+offset-2 on Medium.
chronology_note: All eight badges, Wally beaten on Victory Road 1F, Ever Grande reached, League not entered. pool-96 adds nothing over pool-90; the window-90 additions (Victory Road wilds/signs, Darkranite, Zygardite) are not used. Attempt 2 uses two reachable legends, Chi-Yu (AshenWoods sign, gate 48) and Landorus (Route 111 ruins sign, gate 42), both far upstream; see the manifests' availability audits.
pre_play_strategy_checks: Galvantula lays Sticky Web turn 1 when the fight will last, else Compound Eyes Thunder
Nidoking Sheer Force Earth Power / Sludge Bomb / Ice Beam pressure
Porygon-Z / Mismagius Nasty Plot mode when safe
Mega Latios Tailwind when it enters (alternative speed plan)

attempts.why: Player error more than team strength: Rillaboom led into a Life Orb Bug Buzz (388 OHKO), Whimsicott was switched into a live Porygon-Z and died to Dazzling Gleam + Tri Attack, and Flutter Mane was Choice-locked into Protect. Zacian +1 Close Combat OHKO'd Incineroar; Mega Latios set Tailwind turn 4 then Psyshock swept.

Turn 1 Fake Out Nidoking + Heat Wave (Galvantula Protected, Nidoking to 20). Turn 2 Heat Wave killed both (Galvantula chose Thunder over web). Knock Off broke Mismagius' sash then finished it; Fake Out flinched Zacian; Whimsicott Prankster Tailwind, Mega Kangaskhan Double-Edge killed Porygon-Z before it moved, Zacian CC killed Kangaskhan; Surging Strikes killed -1 Def Zacian; Chi-Yu Dark Pulse OHKO'd Mega Latios. Faints: Kangaskhan, Whimsicott.

strategy_checks.evidence: a1 turn 1 Bug Buzz (KO on Rillaboom, a fair choice); a2 turn 1 Protect, turn 2 Thunder into Chi-Yu (169/242, not a KO) with no web ever set in either run. The plan's 'web when the fight will last' mode did not fire.
a2 turn 2 Thunder hit Chi-Yu for 169
Earth Power selected every turn (a1 t1 flinched, a1 t2 chosen into Incineroar, a2 flinched then died)
a1 turn 6 Mismagius Nasty Plot when Kangaskhan was frozen and Urshifu at 1 HP
'The opposing Zacian's Attack rose!' on every entry; +1 Close Combat OHKO'd Incineroar (a1 t3) and Mega Kangaskhan (a2 t6)
a1 turn 4: Mega Evolved and used Tailwind on its first turn; a2 it attacked instead (Psyshock KO on Whimsicott) with the player's Tailwind already up - sensible

protect_ledger.payoff: blocked a Heat Wave that would have KO'd it (Heat Wave did 269 to Nidoking)
empty in practice - the only attack aimed at it was a Sucker Punch from a frozen Kangaskhan, which fails into a non-attacker anyway; partner Psyshock KO'd Flutter Mane

ai_notes: AI switched Mismagius out for Latios into a Knock Off + Surging Strikes turn (a1 t3) - a good read of the Dark threat. Galvantula never chose Sticky Web across two runs even when its attack was not a KO; not illegal, but the authored web mode is effectively dormant against a lead it cannot OHKO. Worth a look at the web scoring but not a defect.
level_change_rationale: Lost attempt 1 (player errors), won attempt 2 6-2 after a real fight with the ace one-shotting the Mega. Keep.
cooler: The team is already varied and every body threatened something. The web itself was the only piece that never appeared; if the AI keeps preferring Thunder, a second web-abuser (or making Galvantula the slot-2 partner behind a Fake Out) would make the identity show. No set change recommended.
legality_notes: Sets legal; driver accepted the party.
